# Sintesis {-}

#### Vectores Especiales

| $v, u \in \realsn$ | $\in$            |                                           |
| :----------        | :----------      | :-------------------                      |
| $vv^\top$          | $\Mnn$ (rango 1) | $P_v$                                     |
| $v^\top v$         | $\reals$         | $\inner{v}{v} = \|v\|^2$                  |
| $vu^\top$          | $\Mnn$ (rango 1) | descomposicion RC \ $\chi_A(\lambda) = (-\lambda)^{n-1} (v^\top u - \lambda)$ | 
| $v^\top u$         | $\reals$         | $\inner{v}{u} = \|v\|\|u\|\cos\theta$     |

#### Matrices Especiales

+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
|               |                            |                                                              |
+===============+============================+==============================================================+
| Stiefel       | $Q \in \Mmn$\              | - Isometría                                                  |
|               | $\trans{Q} Q = I$          | - Columnas ortonormales                                      |
|               |                            | - $Q\trans{Q} = P_Q$                                         |
|               |                            | - Idempotente, Invariante en $Q$                             |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Ortogonal     | $Q \in \Mnn$               | - Caso particular de Stiefel, ademas cuadrada                |
|               |                            | - Autovectores $\in \mathbb{C}^n$ ortogonales ($v^*w=0$)     |
|               |                            | - $Q^{-1}=\trans{Q}$                                         |
|               |                            | - $\lambda_1\in\mathbb{C},\ |\lambda_i| = 1$                 |
|               |                            | - Isometria (preserva normas y angulos)                      |
|               |                            | - si $\lambda\in\reals$ entonces $\lambda=\pm1$              |
|               |                            | - Rotacion $\det(Q)=1$, o Reflexion $\det(Q)=-1$             |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Simétrica     | $S \in \MRnn$\             | - Autovectores ortogonales                                   |
|               | $S = S^\top$               | - $\lambda \in \reals$                                       |
|               |                            | - $S=Q\Lambda Q^\top$                                        |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Simétrica y   | $S \in \MRnn$\             | - $\lambda=\pm1$                                             |
| Ortogonal     | $S = S^\top$\              |                                                              |
|               | $S^{-1}=S^\top$            |                                                              |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Hermítica     | $S \in \MCnn$\             | - Autovectores ortogonales (en $\mathbb{C}$, $v^*w=0$)       |
|               | $S = S^* = \hermit{S}$     | - $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$                                   |
|               |                            | - $S=Q\Lambda \trans{Q}$                                     |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Antisimétrica | $A$\                       | - $\lambda$ imaginario puro o cero                           |
|               | $\trans{A}=-A$             |                                                              |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Householder   | $H$                        | - $H = (I-2vv^\top)u$                                        |
|               |                            | - Simetrica (proyección ortogonal)                           |
|               |                            | - Involutiva ($H^2=\identity$)                               |
|               |                            | - Ortogonal (isometría)                                      |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Proyección    | $QQ^\top$                  | - $\succeq 0$                                                |
|               |                            | - Simétrica                                                  |
|               |                            | - Idempotente                                                |
|               |                            | - No Invertible, No Ortogonal                                |
+---------------+----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Proyecciónes y Reflexiónes

|||
| :----------------------                      | :----------------            |
| Proyección de $u$ sobre $v$                  | $u_v = (vv^\top)u$           |
| Proyección de $u$ sobre $v^\perp$            | $u_{v^\perp} = (I-vv^\top)u$ |
| Proyección de $u$ sobre $Q$                  | $QQ^\top u$                  |
| Reflección de $u$ sobre hiperplano $v^\perp$ | $H = (I-2vv^\top)u$          |

#### Factorizaciones

|                       | Hipótesis                           | Origen            |
| :----                 | :------------                       | :------           |
| $A = CR$              |                                     |                   |
| $A = X\Lambda X^{-1}$ | $A\in\Mnn$ con $n$ Autovectores l.i.| $AX=X\Lambda$     |
| $S = Q\Lambda Q^\top$ | $S=S^\top$, $S\in\Mnn$              | Teorema Espectral |
| $A = U\Sigma V^\top$  |                                     |                   |
